source_basis: Visual system extracted from the three supplied Slide Science reference screenshots
composition_rules: Use near-white canvases for analytical slides and deep navy for section or synthesis slides.
Keep red below approximately five percent of the slide area.
Use red only for the active decision, delivery gate, deadline, or single focal element.
Build hierarchy with alignment, spacing, typography, and horizontal bands rather than decoration.
Prefer three- or four-column systems for comparable items.
Use large bold numbers with short labels for portfolio summaries.
Keep supporting copy concise and left aligned.
Avoid rounded cards, gradients, neon effects, glass effects, and decorative illustrations.
recommended_layouts: white executive cover with navy focus panel
navy background with four white roadmap cards
KPI row with segmented status bar
three-column comparison with navy action panel
navy synthesis slide with three white decision cards
